audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 John text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for Word of life, seen/touched witness, fellowship, light, confession, cleansing.

verses.restored: What was from beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we looked upon and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life,

familiar.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

verses.restored: and the life was manifested, and we have seen and testify and announce to you the age-long life that was with the Father and was manifested to us,

familiar.text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

verses.restored: what we have seen and heard we announce also to you, so that you also may have fellowship/participation with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: And these things we write so that our joy may be made full.

familiar.text: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

verses.restored: And this is the message that we have heard from him and announce to you: that the Divine is light, and darkness is not in him at all.

familiar.text: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

verses.restored: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in darkness, we lie and do not do the truth.

familiar.text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

verses.restored: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood/life of Jesus his Son cleanses us from every sin/misalignment.

familiar.text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

verses.restored: If we say that we have no sin/misalignment, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

familiar.text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

verses.restored: If we confess our sins/misalignments, he is trustworthy and righteous/just, so that he may release/forgive us the sins/misalignments and cleanse us from every injustice/unrighteousness.

familiar.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.restored: If we say that we have not sinned/misaligned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

familiar.text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

translation_notes: 1 John begins with embodied witness: heard, seen, looked upon, touched.
Koinonia is fellowship/participation, not mere sentiment.
Walking in light includes truthful confession and cleansing, not denial of misalignment.
